memo.text:
Re-open D01: Cap file uploads at 10 MB
Moot verdict as of 2026-10-16: MOOT

Which reason broke
- "The API gateway enforces a 10 MB request body limit" (the stated reason, "All file uploads pass through the API gateway", only holds because of it): expired.

The new evidence
- 2026-03-02 PR-412: Raise the API gateway body limit to 100 MB. Quote: "Upgrades Envoy to 1.31 and raises the request body limit on the gateway from 10 MB to 100 MB. Load-tested with 95 MB payloads; p99 latency unchanged. The old 10 MB limit was a default we never…"

Other decisions resting on the same reason
- D02 Chunk CSV imports into 5 MB parts (MOOT)
- D03 Reject photos over 8 MB in the mobile app (MOOT)

Suggested owner for the follow-up: Kwame Boateng (Ada Okafor left on 2026-05-15; reporting line Ada Okafor (left 2026-05-15) → Kwame Boateng)

queries.cypher: MATCH (d:Decision {id: $id}) OPTIONAL MATCH (n:Decision)-[su:SUPERSEDES]->(d) WHERE su.at <= $as_of AND coalesce(su.stated, su.at) <= $as_of OPTIONAL MATCH (x:Evidence)-[rt:RETIRES]->(d) WHERE rt.at <= $as_of AND coalesce(rt.stated, rt.at) <= $as_of OPTIONAL MATCH (d)-[:RECORDED_IN]->(src:Evidence) OPTIONAL MATCH (d)-[:GOVERNS]->(s:System) RETURN d, n.id, n.title, su.at, x.id, x.title, rt.at, rt.quote, src, collect(DISTINCT s.name)
